test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-6) Official paper (Held On: 9 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Benkat's birthday on 01st January 2012 was a Sunday. On what day will his next birthday be?
solution:
• As 2012 is divisible by 4. So, it is a leap year.
 
• Number of odd days in a leap year = Remainder of (366 ÷ 7) = 2
 
• So, on 01st January 2013, the day would be → Day on 01st Jan 2012 + 2 

 → Sunday + 2

 → **Tuesday**

Hence, **'option 2' **is the correct answer.
